results.title: Bone Voyage
results.overview: Two siblings accidently broke the urn that was keeping the ashes of their mother, making them scatter. They need to gather them all to make their mom go to peace because their mom said so, leading to a second goodbye.

results.title: Detective Agency
results.overview: When a serial killer, gangsters, and bottom-feeding private detectives cross paths… things can get really messy and bloody! A serial killer that has been in hiding is finally caught- but the story is far from over. A dirty cop learns that one of the killer's victims had actually stolen a national treasure, a golden Buddha statue that's worth millions; which no one has been able to locate for more than a decade. So begins a treasure hunt- and it's up for grabs for anyone, from a dirty cop to gangs and lowlife private detectives!

results.title: Les ailes
results.overview: After having his license revoked for health reasons, an aviator must accept that he will never fly again.

results.title: Werewolf Game
results.overview: Twelve kidnapped strangers must play a game where they vote on who amongst them to murder. At night, the "werewolves" hidden among them come out to brutally kill one of the 12 "villagers" in return. The days repeat until one winning group remains.

results.title: Badak
results.overview: Badak reflects on extraction as both method and worldview – on the pulling of value and meaning from creatures, minerals and landscapes, and the scars left behind.

results.title: Girl Dad
results.overview: Across laughter and quiet conversations that span years, a father and daughter navigate the joy of being together and the pain of a love that must learn to endure being apart.

results.title: My Family's Killer Affairs
results.overview: Nikki finds out that one of her eggs mistakenly got implanted into someone else during an IVF treatment 20 years ago, she's shocked to meet Jenell, the daughter she never knew.

results.title: 8 Minutes Of War
results.overview: Following the gripping predecessor 6 Minutes of War, which was set on the Eastern Front, this short film now takes you to the Western Front of World War II. In intense images, and only eight minutes long, the film depicts the struggle for survival, the brutality of war, and the fates of soldiers caught between chaos and hope.

results.title: Die Nuklearfalle - Putins Deals mit dem Westen
results.original_title: Die Nuklearfalle - Putins Deals mit dem Westen
results.overview: An enlightening investigative report on Rosatom, Russia's powerful atomic energy agency and Vladimir Putin's formidable geopolitical tool for increasing his influence around the world.

results.title: Dorchester: au coeur de la mêlée
results.original_title: Dorchester: au coeur de la mêlée
results.overview: Under Dorchester Square in Montreal lies the cemetery where 55,000 people were buried in the 19th century. The square is still at the heart of social conflicts in Quebec, 150 years later.

results.title: Frames
results.overview: Carter, a successful but enigmatic photographer, invites a group of 4 individuals to stay at his luxurious estate under the guise of an artistic project with a lucrative reward.

results.title: One Thousand Black Umbrellas
results.original_title: Seribu Payung Hitam dan Sisanya Rindu

results.title: The Prime Minister vs the Blob: Liz Truss's 44 Days in Office
results.original_title: The Prime Minister vs the Blob: Liz Truss's 44 Days in Office
results.overview: An exploration of Liz Truss' short-lived tenure as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. What started as a Thatcherite plan to grow the economy ended in a dramatic political tale of blunders and betrayals.

results.title: Northern Tōhoku 2Days 2025 Stardom in Akita ~FM Akita 40th Anniversary Special Sponsorship~

results.overview: Northern Tōhoku 2Days 2025 Stardom in Akita ~FM Akita 40th Anniversary Special Sponsorship~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on July 16, 2025, at Selion Plaza in Akita, Japan.

results.title: Metallica: Polar Beach Party
results.overview: Recorded live at the Polar Beach Party, Tuktoyaktuk, Canada on September 3, 1995.

results.title: Sarhadein
results.overview: In Dubai, two roomies—one Indian, one Pakistani—are locked in a fierce but hilarious rivalry. But when a love triangle shakes things up, their bromance goes next level, showing that deep down, they’re all about unity beyond borders.

results.title: How to Groom Your Rabbit
results.overview: An at-home tutorial with “The Bunny Groomer” explores the agony and ecstasy of pursuing your passion.

results.title: Akris: Fashion With a Heritage
results.overview: Told in a deeply personal and emotional way, AKRIS: FASHION WITH A HERITAGE switches between present and past by tracing the Kriemler family’s legacy — from founder Alice Kriemler-Schoch, to her successors Max and Ute, and on to today’s leaders, who continue to shape the future of AKRIS with great respect and responsibility for the company, the past and the people who made it work so successfully.

results.title: The Christmas Decoy
results.overview: A socially awkward man finds himself stuck in a holiday love triangle and learns that doing the right thing can lead to something real.
